title: Oral Presentation & Communication
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Structure complex information so a specific audience can follow it — live, in the time you have.

steps.title: Know your audience
steps.text: Decide what they already know, so you can pitch the detail and the jargon right.

steps.title: Pick one core message
steps.text: Choose the single thing they must remember; shape everything around it.

steps.title: Structure with signposts
steps.text: Give a clear path — tell them where you are going, and mark each turn.

steps.title: Pitch the jargon level
steps.text: Translate specialist terms for a mixed audience without dumbing down the ideas.

steps.title: Rehearse for time
steps.text: Practise aloud and cut to fit — overrunning is a design failure, not bad luck.

feedForward.text: State your talk’s one core message in a sentence, and the three signposts that get the audience there.
